Prism gallery

Every spec example, both stacks side by side, per scheme and density — the living visual canon of ADR-0005. Generated by pnpm gallery:build from the snapshots each harness already compares against; it renders nothing of its own. A pair is found by name alone: <Component>/<exampleId>.<platform>.<scheme>.<density>[.<variant>].png.

The two stacks frame their renders differently, and this page does not hide it. Every image is shown at its own size, one image pixel per CSS pixel, with that size under it — so a picture that is wider is wider, not scaled. Read the framing column below before reading a difference as drift.

Platform keyWhere the images liveHow they are framedWhat recorded them
ios, ipados, macos, watchos
dimmed: this root may hold that key, nothing records it yet		swift/Tests/DSSnapshotTests/__Snapshots__
swift/Tests/DSSnapshotTests (DSExampleSnapshotTests)		tight to the component: the view is proposed the phone’s 402 pt width and keeps its own height, so there is no page around it
one image point per pixel (scale 1), Dynamic Type Large, en_US/UTC		iPhone 17, iOS 26.5 · Xcode build 17F113, iphonesimulator26.5
web-desktop, web-touchweb/apps/vrt/baselines/linux
web/apps/vrt (tests/stories.spec.ts)		the story’s stage: `.ds-gallery-stage` includes the ground the example is staged on (a page, a map, an image), so the image is wider and taller than the component
deviceScaleFactor 1, en-US/UTC; `web-desktop` is a 1280×800 window, `web-touch` a 390×844 phone		mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.63.0-noble

Columns: iOS, web-desktop, web-touch. No image carries ipados, macos, watchos yet, so those platform keys have no column; a set recorded for one lands beside its pair with no rename. The parity report links each spec row to its section here.

1748 image(s) over 872 cell(s): 872 complete, 0 missing. 10 of 57 component spec(s) have snapshots; 3 pattern spec(s) have none by design (ADR-0012 rule 3).
